description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange Effective from 31.12.2018 to 06.01.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
